NYC’s CBGB closed 20 years ago today.

The Patti Smith Group performed — joined by special guests Richard Lloyd of Television and Flea of Red Hot Chili Peppers — and Talking Heads’ Chris Frantz and Tina Weymouth, the E Street Band’s Steven Van Zandt, and Jesse Malin also attended.
